sections.heading: Is this person legally permitted to teach your child for money?
paragraphs: This is the question most families skip and the one with the clearest answer. Private tutoring in the UAE is permitted and regulated. Individuals providing private lessons need a MoHRE private tuition work permit under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, and MoHRE states that individuals offering private tutoring without a permit will be subject to fines and penalties outlined in the applicable laws. No fine schedule is published, so any figure circulating online should be treated as unverified.

The permit itself is undemanding and that is the point: there is no reason for a working tutor not to hold one. MoHRE's service page lists it as Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, with no fee and a two-working-day completion time, applied for through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system. It is granted free of charge for two years. A tutor who tells you the permit does not apply to them, or that it does not cover online lessons, is telling you something about how they run their affairs.

There is a second rule worth knowing in this emirate because it is widely misunderstood. A teacher at your child's own school is generally not an appropriate choice for paid private tuition of that same child. Abu Dhabi's ADEK professional-ethics rules bar school staff from paid private tutoring of students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit carries a code of conduct that also addresses serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school. This has been press-reported rather than read from the current policy document, so verify it against the authority's own text before relying on the exact wording, but the direction of travel is unambiguous.

sections.heading: Reading a school report and an inspection judgement before you hire anybody
paragraphs: A surprising proportion of tutoring in this emirate is bought against the wrong target. A parent sees a disappointing overall grade, buys a weekly session in that subject, and discovers in March that the problem was exam technique in two paper sections rather than content across a syllabus. The cheapest diagnostic available is already in the house: the last two marked scripts, the most recent school report, and the published inspection judgement on the school.

The Department of Knowledge regulates private education in Ras Al Khaimah and, as in Sharjah, approves fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. What a parent can take from a school-level judgement is narrower than it looks: the band is awarded to an institution, not to a classroom, and a strong school can have one department carrying a weak subject. The useful move is to read the judgement for the subject and the phase your child sits in, then ask the school directly how the subject's own outcomes compare with the overall band.

The report tells you where to look; the marked script tells you what to do. Read a script for the pattern rather than the total: method marks lost on questions with the right final answer point at working and presentation, not understanding. Marks lost in the last third of a paper point at pacing. Marks lost on command terms - describe answered as explain, deduce answered as state - point at a specific and quickly fixable deficit. A tutor who starts there will cost less over a year than one who starts at chapter one, because the sessions are aimed at something.

sections.heading: What a strong tutor refuses to do, and what happens when nobody covers the subject
paragraphs: The clearest quality signal in this market is a refusal. Coursework, extended writing and internally assessed work must be the student's own, and a tutor who offers to get a piece finished is offering something that puts the student at risk rather than the tutor. One site ranking in this market sells completed internal assessments outright. That is a malpractice trigger for the candidate, and a parent paying for it is buying an exposure, not a grade. Teaching, feedback on a draft the student wrote, and coaching on process are legitimate. Producing the work is not.

The same applies to materials. Board syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes and grade-boundary tables belong to Cambridge, Pearson and the IB, and are referenced and linked rather than handed over as downloads. A tutor who offers a folder of everything is a convenience in the short run and a copyright problem for whoever distributed it. Work from the official pages, and ask the school which documents it has already provided.

Honesty about availability is the last signal, and it is the one competitors in this market conceal. Some subjects and tiers simply do not have a UAE-based specialist free at the hour a Ras Al Khaimah family needs. Additional Mathematics, Extended-tier physics and several option subjects come up repeatedly. When that happens the straight answer is to say so, name the alternative - a specialist in another time zone teaching at a Gulf Standard Time slot, or a different session pattern - and let the family decide. No tutor can promise a grade, and anyone who does in a first conversation has told you how the rest of the relationship will go.

process.title: Send the codes, not the subject
process.description: Start with the syllabus codes from your child's entry list, the tier, and the school's current teaching order. If you do not have them, one email to the school office produces all three. This single step removes most of the mismatch risk before anybody is matched.

process.title: Share the last two marked scripts
process.description: A recent test and a recent piece of written work say more than a report. They show whether marks are being lost on method, pacing or command terms, and they let the first session start on a diagnosis instead of a general chapter review.

process.title: A short consultation, then one trial session at no charge
process.description: The consultation confirms the code, the tier and the time slot in Gulf Standard Time. One trial session per family follows at no charge, after which you decide. Nothing beyond that session is committed, and there is no term block to exit.

process.title: Agree a plan in writing that names topics
process.description: Ask for the plan after the trial in writing, however brief. It should name papers, topics and a sequence. A plan that names attitudes rather than topics cannot be measured, and an unmeasurable plan is how a year of weekly sessions passes without a change in outcome.

process.title: Review against the next marked script
process.description: Set a review point at the next school assessment rather than at a number of weeks. The question at that point is whether the marks moved in the sections the plan targeted. If they did not, the plan was aimed wrongly and should change, which is a normal event rather than a failure.

whyPoints.title: The pool is defined by the code, not by the drive
whyPoints.description: Matching starts from the syllabus code and tier rather than from a postcode. In an emirate where a subject cohort can be a dozen students, that is the difference between a specialist in the paper and a generalist covering three sciences in one slot.

whyPoints.title: Rates on this page are the market's, with sources
whyPoints.description: Every AED figure published here is attributed to the provider that published it and dated to October 2026. Three of the main competing sites in this market publish no hourly figure at all, and the two that do quote in US dollars.

whyPoints.title: The honesty line is stated before you ask
whyPoints.description: Coursework support is teaching and feedback on the student's own writing. Board papers and mark schemes are linked at source rather than redistributed. These limits are written here so that a family does not have to discover them during an internal assessment week.

whyPoints.title: Scheduling is built around the local school day
whyPoints.description: Sessions run in Gulf Standard Time and are set around the end of the school day, club commitments and prayer timings, with the Ramadan timetable adjusted rather than suspended. Slots move inside the same week when a school event intervenes.

whyPoints.title: Availability limits are disclosed, not hidden
whyPoints.description: Where no UAE-based specialist covers a subject at the hour you need, that is said plainly along with the alternative. Several providers in this market route families to a foreign phone number instead of disclosing where delivery happens.

whyPoints.description: IB Gram is an independent tutor-matching platform. It holds no approval, accreditation or partnership from any education regulator or examination board, and no school named on this page is a client or partner. Those are statements of fact rather than modesty.

faqs.question: Is there an official ranking of IGCSE tutors in Ras Al Khaimah?
faqs.answer: No. The RAK Department of Knowledge regulates private education in the emirate and approves school fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods, but its remit covers institutions rather than individuals. MoHRE issues a private tuition work permit, which establishes that someone may legally teach for money and tests nothing about subject competence. Any site presenting a ranked list of tutors is ranking its own customers. The practical substitute is evidence you can check in one conversation: the syllabus code your child is entered for, the paper structure under that code, the tier of the entry, and what the last marked script shows about where marks were lost.

faqs.question: How do I check in one conversation whether a tutor actually knows the syllabus?
faqs.answer: Ask which syllabus code your child is entered for and what the papers under it are worth. A specialist answers flatly and quickly, names the tier, and distinguishes Cambridge 0580 from Pearson 4MA1 without prompting. A generalist talks about covering all the boards. Then ask what they want to see before the first lesson. The useful answer is the last two marked scripts and the school's teaching order; the weak answer is the textbook. Finally, ask what they will not do with coursework. A tutor who says the writing stays the student's own work has told you where their limits are before you had to test them.

faqs.question: My son's school enters Pearson Edexcel. Does a Cambridge-trained tutor still work?
faqs.answer: Often yes, but only if they say so openly and adjust. The content overlap between Cambridge 0620 and Pearson 4CH1 is large; the paper structure, practical assessment route and data-question style are not identical, and past-paper practice has to come from the right board. A tutor who has taught both will tell you which parts of their usual approach change. A tutor who says the boards are basically the same will teach the overlap and discover the difference during the mock season. Confirm the code from the school's entry statement and give it to the tutor before the first session rather than after it.

faqs.question: What should a trial session produce before we commit to anything?
faqs.answer: A written plan that names topics and papers. Forty-five minutes with an organised adult tells you very little, because a pleasant generalist and a subject specialist look alike over that span. What differs is the output: a specialist leaves you with a sequence that cites the specification, identifies two or three topics in order, says which paper sections the marks are sitting in, and sets a point at which to review. A plan describing confidence, motivation and rapport cannot be measured against anything. Ask for the plan in writing, however short, and read it for nouns rather than adjectives.

faqs.question: Is a tuition centre in Al Nakheel better value than one-to-one for IGCSE maths?
faqs.answer: It is a different service rather than a cheaper version of the same one. A group revision class is cost-effective when the whole group shares the same gap and the aim is broad coverage before a series. It stops being effective when your child's problem is specific: method marks lost on questions answered correctly, or pacing collapsing in the last third of a paper. Centres also tend to teach to a phase rather than to a code, which matters if your child sits a different board from most of the room. Check which board the class is built around before booking a term.

faqs.question: Does paying more per hour get a stronger IGCSE tutor?
faqs.answer: Not reliably, because the hourly rate contains things other than skill. A visiting tutor's fee includes the drive, which on the northern strip or Al Marjan Island can be most of the cost. A premium rate frequently reflects scarcity: a subject few people teach costs more because few people teach it. An agency rate includes the agency. Published market figures in October 2026 ranged from AED 45 at the budget end to AED 650 at the premium end, and the useful question is what sits inside the hour rather than where the number falls in that range.

faqs.question: How many hours a week does an Extended-tier student in Year 11 actually need?
faqs.answer: One well-aimed hour a week per subject, sustained, beats three unfocused ones. Most families here start with a single weekly slot in the subject where the marked scripts show the largest recoverable total, add a second subject only if the first is moving, and switch to a short dense block after mocks when the target is specific papers. Two sessions a week across a full exam year is a material financial commitment, so it is worth sizing before starting. What changes outcomes is whether the hour is aimed at something identified in a script, not the number of hours bought.

faqs.question: Can my daughter move from Core to Extended tier before the entry closes?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the window is earlier than parents expect. The tier is set when the school makes the entry, and Cambridge publishes final entry deadlines months before the papers: for a June sitting the entry closes in the spring, roughly four months ahead of the first paper, and the November series has its own earlier deadline. Once entries are submitted the tier is fixed for that series, and the only honest version of the date is the one the centre gives you in writing. If your daughter is near the line, ask the school which tier she is being entered for and when that becomes final, then work on algebraic fluency, which is what usually separates the tiers and is the part that responds fastest to teaching.

faqs.question: What qualifications should I expect an IGCSE science tutor to hold?
faqs.answer: A degree in the subject rather than in education generally, plus demonstrable teaching of the specific code. The permit system does not test this: MoHRE's private tuition work permit is open to registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18 alike. So the qualification question has to be asked directly. For Extended-tier chemistry or physics, ask which code they teach most often, how they handle the practical paper when teaching remotely, and to see an example of marked feedback they have given on a past paper.

faqs.question: How do I verify a private tutor's MoHRE permit before the first lesson?
faqs.answer: Ask to see it. The permit is issued through MoHRE under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge for two years, and the service appears on MoHRE's own site as Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, with no fee and a two-working-day completion time via the smart app, website and e-services system. Because it costs nothing and takes two days, there is no good reason for a working tutor not to hold one. MoHRE states that individuals tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no fine schedule is published, so treat any figure you see quoted as unverified.

faqs.question: We live in Al Dhait and the specialist is in another country. Does that matter?
faqs.answer: It matters for scheduling and for nothing else, provided the format is genuinely one-to-one and live. Sessions are set in Gulf Standard Time around the local school day, so the tutor's location affects their working hours rather than your child's. What it changes in your favour is the pool: instead of choosing among people willing to drive to Al Dhait twice a week, you are choosing among people who teach the specific code. In an emirate with small subject cohorts, that swap is usually the difference between a specialist and a generalist covering three subjects.

faqs.question: Will a tutor help my child finish a piece of IGCSE coursework by Friday?
faqs.answer: Not in the sense the question usually means. A tutor can teach the skills the task assesses, explain what the criteria reward, and give feedback on a draft your child has written. A tutor cannot write it, rewrite it to completion, or supply a version to adapt. Work that must be the student's own has to stay the student's own, and the risk of crossing that line falls on the candidate rather than on the tutor. One site ranking in this market sells completed internal assessments outright; a parent buying that is buying an exposure. If a deadline is tomorrow, the honest help is triage and planning.

faqs.question: Does my child need five or six IGCSE passes for UAE equivalency?
faqs.answer: On the British track, students must show passes in five accredited subjects in GCSE or IGCSE certificates at a grade no lower than E or grade 3, and Arabic and Islamic education are not included among those five. Above that, the requirement is one accredited subject at Advanced Level at grade E or better, or two accredited subjects at Advanced Subsidiary Level at the same grade. One competing site in this market states that UAE candidates must take six IGCSE subjects, which does not match the published rule. Equivalency is a ministry process; verify the current requirements on the ministry's own channel before acting on any restatement, including this one.

faqs.question: What happens if nobody can teach the IGCSE subject my child has chosen?
faqs.answer: You get told, with the alternative named. Some subjects and tiers have no UAE-based specialist free at the hour a Ras Al Khaimah family needs: Additional Mathematics 0606, Extended-tier physics and several option subjects come up repeatedly. The options at that point are a specialist in another time zone teaching into a Gulf Standard Time slot, a different session pattern such as a fortnightly longer session, or waiting for a slot to open. None of those is hidden behind a form. No provider in this market discloses a coverage limit, which is exactly why it is written here.

faqs.question: Does the inspection judgement on my child's school tell me anything useful about tutoring?
faqs.answer: It tells you where to look, not what to buy. A judgement is awarded to an institution, so a strong overall band can sit above one department that is carrying a weaker subject, and a weaker band does not mean every classroom is weak. Read the judgement for the subject and the phase your child is actually in, then ask the school how that subject's own outcomes compare with the overall picture. Pair that with the last two marked scripts, which show whether marks are going on method, pacing or command terms. The report narrows the question; the script answers it.

ras-al-khaimah/best-igcse-tutor.closingBody: If you take one thing from this page, make it the email to the school office asking for the syllabus codes and the tier on your child's entry list. Those three facts turn an unanswerable search into a specific question a specialist can answer in minutes. Send them with the last two marked scripts and a workable weekday window in Gulf Standard Time, and the consultation can start on a diagnosis rather than an introduction. Lessons are one-to-one and delivered live online; IB Gram does not send a tutor to a Ras Al Khaimah address, and it holds no regulator or examination-board approval. What it does is match a student to someone who teaches their code.

ras-al-khaimah/cambridge-igcse-additiona.tutorsIntro: The tutors below teach Cambridge Additional Mathematics and the AS Mathematics content that follows it. Each profile names the boards and levels the tutor actually teaches, so you are choosing a 0606 teacher rather than a general maths tutor who has seen the paper once.

intro.heading: Why 0606 is the hardest IGCSE to staff in the northern emirates
paragraphs: Additional Mathematics 0606 is not a harder version of 0580. It is a different qualification, sat in the same series, that reaches into material most students do not meet until the first year of AS. A candidate is expected to differentiate products and quotients, integrate to find an area, prove a trigonometric identity, expand a binomial, work with matrices and vectors, and move between radians and degrees without pausing to think about it. Schools enter students for it as a bridge into AS Mathematics 9709 or into IB Mathematics Analysis and Approaches, usually after a strong grade in 0580 Extended.

In Ras Al Khaimah the practical difficulty is supply rather than difficulty. The emirate's private-school set is small and concentrated: British and international provision around Al Hamra and the southern coast, Indian-curriculum and mixed provision through Al Nakheel, Khuzam and Al Uraibi. A cohort of twelve or fifteen students taking an optional extension subject does not justify a dedicated specialist on every timetable, so 0606 is often taught in a lunchtime group by the teacher with the most free periods, or taken by a student who is largely working alone from a textbook.

That is why remote teaching matters more here than it does in Dubai. A family in Al Dhait is not choosing between six local 0606 teachers and an online one. The honest comparison is between an online specialist and nobody, or between an online specialist and a general maths tutor who will teach the 0580 content your child already knows. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes in the UAE; home visits are a service offered only in India. Every UAE lesson is one-to-one over live video, which is also the reason a Ras Al Khaimah student can be taught by a 0606 specialist at all.

This page is written against the emirate as it actually works: the Department of Knowledge as the regulator, the Cambridge June and November series as the sessions local candidates sit, and the Ministry of Education equivalency rules that decide what the certificate is worth afterwards. It sets out the syllabus content, the question types where marks disappear, the market rate in AED, the entry calendar read backwards from the paper, and the boundary a tutor does not cross on school-set work.

If your child has just been entered for 0606 and the first problem set has come home covered in red ink, the gap is almost always notation and method rather than ability. That is a teachable problem, and the first lesson is spent finding out which of the six or seven likely gaps it is. The commonest are calculator mode, answer-only working, and an inability to spot that an equation is a quadratic wearing a different hat. None of those three takes long to repair once somebody has named it, which is why a diagnostic lesson is worth more at this stage than a term of general practice.

ras-al-khaimah/cambridge-igcse-additiona.programmesIntro: 0606 only makes sense as part of a route. These are the three stages a Ras Al Khaimah student moves through either side of it, and what support looks like at each.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics (Extended)
programmes.description: The core qualification every 0606 candidate takes alongside. Extended tier runs Papers 2 and 4, covers the full grade range to A*, and assumes fluency in algebraic manipulation, surds, indices and graph transformation. A student who is still hesitant with rearranging formulae in 0580 will not cope with the differentiation in 0606, because the calculus is easy and the algebra underneath it is not.
programmes.countryNote: Across Ras Al Khaimah the Extended tier is the standard entry at British-curriculum campuses on the southern coast and at the city-side Indian-curriculum schools that use Cambridge. Tier is set by the centre, appears on the statement of entry, and can usually still be changed before the final entry date, which is the single most useful thing a parent can check in Year 10.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Additional Mathematics
programmes.description: Two written papers, two hours each, 80 marks each, half the grade apiece, graded A* to E. Content spans functions, quadratics, the modulus function, logarithms and exponentials, straight-line geometry, circular measure in radians, trigonometry including identities and equations, series and the binomial theorem, vectors, matrices, differentiation and integration, and kinematics treated by calculus.
programmes.countryNote: Few Ras Al Khaimah timetables carry it as a taught option with dedicated periods. Students are commonly entered on the strength of a mock result and then taught in a shared group or asked to self-study. If your child is in that position, say so in the consultation, because a self-study candidate needs a different lesson structure from one following a taught scheme of work.

programmes.name: AS Mathematics and IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
programmes.description: Where 0606 leads. Pure Mathematics 1 in Cambridge 9709 revisits quadratics, functions, circular measure, trigonometry, series, differentiation and integration at a deeper level, and the overlap with 0606 is substantial. IB Analysis and Approaches assumes the same algebraic fluency and adds proof, sequences and, at Higher Level, considerably more calculus.
programmes.countryNote: Students leaving a Ras Al Khaimah school at sixteen split three ways: AS and A Level at the same campus or in Sharjah, the IB Diploma at the emirate's international provision, or a foundation year at a UAE university. All three reward a 0606 candidate who has actually understood the calculus rather than memorised six question shapes.

ras-al-khaimah/cambridge-igcse-additiona.subjectsIntro: 0606 is one syllabus, but tutoring it means teaching eight or nine distinct bodies of content. These are the blocks a 0606 course is built from, and what each one is really testing.

subjects.name: Functions, domain and the modulus
subjects.description: Composite and inverse functions, domain and range stated properly, and the modulus function graphed and solved. Marks are lost on range notation and on forgetting that an inverse exists only where the function is one-to-one. Questions are often the first on a paper and set the tone for the rest of the two hours.

subjects.name: Quadratics, discriminants and inequalities
subjects.description: Completing the square, the discriminant as a condition rather than a formula, quadratic inequalities solved by sketch, and quadratic-in-disguise equations in e to the x or in a trigonometric ratio. A great many 0606 marks hang on recognising that a messy equation is a quadratic in something other than x.

subjects.name: Logarithms and exponentials
subjects.description: Laws of logarithms, solving equations by taking logs, and linearising a relationship so that a graph of log y against log x gives a straight line whose gradient and intercept carry meaning. The straight-line-from-logs question appears often and rewards a student who writes down the comparison with y equals mx plus c explicitly.

subjects.name: Circular measure and radians
subjects.description: Arc length, sector area and composite shapes with a calculator set to radians. The single most common avoidable error in the whole syllabus is a calculator left in degree mode. Teaching here is half geometry and half habit: convert, check, label the diagram, then compute.

subjects.name: Trigonometry, identities and proof
subjects.description: Solving trigonometric equations across a stated interval, using the Pythagorean identities, and proving an identity from one side to the other. Proof questions are where 0606 separates students most sharply, because a proof cannot be guessed and the mark scheme follows the argument rather than the answer.

subjects.name: Series and the binomial theorem
subjects.description: Arithmetic and geometric progressions, sums to infinity with the convergence condition stated, and binomial expansion including a single named term or a coefficient. Sign errors inside the bracket and dropped powers in the general term account for most of the lost marks here, and both respond quickly to drilling.

subjects.name: Differentiation and its applications
subjects.description: Product, quotient and chain rules, derivatives of trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions, tangents and normals, stationary points classified by the second derivative, small increments and connected rates of change. The method marks sit in the setting out, so a tutor spends as much time on layout as on the differentiation itself.

subjects.name: Integration and area
subjects.description: Integration as reverse differentiation, definite integrals, area between a curve and a line, and integrating composite forms. Students who are fluent at differentiating often stall here because integration requires recognising a pattern rather than applying a rule, which is a different kind of practice.

subjects.name: Vectors, matrices and kinematics
subjects.description: Vector addition and magnitude, position vectors and simple geometry, matrix multiplication, determinants and inverses, and kinematics handled by differentiating or integrating a displacement, velocity or acceleration function. The kinematics questions are the clearest example in the syllabus of calculus used for something, which makes them useful teaching ground.

ras-al-khaimah/cambridge-igcse-additiona.regionsIntro: Ras Al Khaimah is spread out, and where a family lives changes the school run, the lesson slot and the realistic alternatives to online teaching. These are the areas 0606 enquiries come from.

regions.name: Al Nakheel
regions.note: The city centre and the densest concentration of school places in the emirate. Families here have the shortest school run and the most tuition-centre options, but centre classes are group classes in 0580, not 0606.

regions.name: Al Dhait North and South
regions.note: Residential and well served by the city schools. An afternoon slot starting at 4.30pm works once the bus has arrived, and that twenty-minute margin matters more than it sounds for a two-hour paper practice.

regions.name: Khuzam
regions.note: Serves both the British campus nearby and city-side schools. Households here often have one child on a Cambridge route and another on an Indian-curriculum route, which makes syllabus-code precision useful rather than pedantic.

regions.name: Al Hamra Village and Al Jazirah Al Hamra
regions.note: Southern coastal community close to the emirate's British and international provision. The commute north into the city for tuition is the long one, which is why remote lessons are chosen here most often.

regions.name: Mina Al Arab and Hayat Island

sections.heading: What a 0606 search in Ras Al Khaimah is usually about
paragraphs: Parents who type this query are almost never shopping for general maths help. They are reacting to something specific: a Year 11 report that separates 0580 and 0606 into two different grades, a mock score that fell off a cliff, or a school letter saying their child has been entered for an additional qualification nobody at home has heard of. The first useful thing to establish is that 0606 is a separate Cambridge syllabus with its own entry, its own two papers and its own grade, and that it is graded A* to E.

The second is that a strong 0580 grade does not predict a strong 0606 grade. 0580 Extended rewards accurate work across a wide, familiar content range. 0606 rewards method on unfamiliar ground: recognising a quadratic in disguise, choosing between the product and the chain rule, knowing that a proof must be argued from one side rather than worked from both ends. Students who have coasted on arithmetic fluency and good memory meet a wall somewhere around differentiation, and it arrives suddenly.

The third is availability. In this emirate the subject-specialist pool within a short drive is thin, and families in Mina Al Arab, Al Marjan Island or the inland belt have the added arithmetic of distance. Teaching this syllabus one-to-one over live video is not a compromise forced by geography; it is what makes a 0606 specialist reachable from a northern-emirate living room at all. The trade-off a parent should weigh is set out with numbers further down this page rather than asserted here.

sections.heading: From 0580 Extended to 0606, topic by topic
paragraphs: The clearest way to see what 0606 asks is to put it next to the syllabus your child is already sitting. Most of the content below exists in some form in 0580 Extended, but the treatment changes: a technique that was an answer becomes a tool, and the question stops telling the student which tool to pick. That shift, rather than any single new topic, is what makes the first term of 0606 feel disproportionately hard.

The table is the version of this comparison we use in a first lesson. A student who can look at it and say which rows feel comfortable has effectively written their own teaching order, and a parent who reads it stops worrying that their child has become bad at maths. Nothing in the right-hand column is beyond a candidate who holds a solid grade in 0580 Extended, but every row needs teaching rather than practice alone.

One practical note on sequencing. Calculus sits at the end of most schemes of work and at the heart of both papers, so a candidate who arrives in February with differentiation untaught is in a worse position than the mock mark suggests. Where a student is self-studying, we usually bring differentiation forward and teach it before series and vectors, because it has the longest tail of applications and the most method marks attached to it.

The matrices and vectors rows are the ones families most often dismiss as small. They are small in teaching time and large in exam value, because the questions are short, self-contained and easy to secure, which makes them the cheapest marks on either paper for a student who is otherwise struggling. A sensible rescue plan for a weak candidate starts with those two rows and with circular measure, then moves to calculus with whatever time is left.

sections.heading: Where 0606 marks actually go missing
paragraphs: A 0606 script rarely loses marks evenly. It loses them in clusters, and the clusters are predictable enough that a tutor who has marked a few hundred of these papers can usually name a student's pattern after one timed paper. Diagnosing the pattern is the fastest available improvement, because it converts hours of general revision into three or four specific repairs.

The most expensive habit is answer-only working. 0606 mark schemes allocate method marks generously, and a student who writes down a derivative and a final coordinate without the intermediate line has thrown away marks that were available even when the answer is wrong. The second most expensive is calculator mode: radians are used throughout the syllabus, and a degree-mode sector calculation produces a plausible wrong number that will not be caught in a read-through.

The table below lists the question shapes that recur across recent series, what the mark scheme wants, and the error that costs most. We use it as a checklist in the final fortnight, with the student marking each row honestly as secure, shaky or unseen. That self-assessment is more accurate than a predicted grade and considerably more useful, because it maps directly onto what the remaining sessions should cover.

Two further patterns are worth naming because they are invisible on a mark total. The first is the student who abandons a question after one failed approach rather than restarting it with a different method, which on a paper of this length costs whole blocks of marks rather than single ones. The second is the student who does all the mathematics correctly and answers a different question from the one asked, usually by finding a coordinate when the question wanted a gradient, or an exact value when it wanted three significant figures. Both are habits, and habits respond to timed practice with somebody reading the script afterwards.

sections.heading: Two papers, four hours, and the arithmetic of the clock
paragraphs: 0606 is examined by two written papers. Each runs two hours, carries 80 marks and counts for half the grade, which means there is no component that can be written off and no coursework cushion. Four hours of examination across one series decides the whole qualification, and both papers draw on the full syllabus rather than splitting it between them. A student cannot revise half the content and sit the paper that covers it.

Eighty marks in 120 minutes gives roughly ninety seconds a mark, and the later questions carry more marks than the early ones, so pacing is not evenly distributed. Students who are strong on content and weak on pace typically lose between eight and fifteen marks per paper to unfinished final questions, which is a grade boundary or more. The repair is timed practice with a per-question budget written on the paper, not additional content teaching.

The last fortnight of preparation should therefore look different from the rest of the course. Full papers, taken to time, marked against the published mark scheme, with the review focused on where method marks were available and not claimed. Confirm the structure and the permitted equipment for your child's exam year against the current syllabus on cambridgeinternational.org or with the school's exams officer, because component details are reviewed between syllabus cycles and the statement of entry is the document that settles it.

One scheduling point specific to this emirate. Both papers usually fall inside the same fortnight, and in a small centre they can sit close together, with other subjects between them. A candidate taking eight or nine IGCSEs will meet 0606 in the middle of the heaviest two weeks of the year, not at the start of them, so revision for it has to be finished earlier than feels natural. Families who plan the final month around the timetable rather than around the subject list consistently find the last fortnight calmer.

sections.heading: Why so few northern-emirate timetables carry 0606
paragraphs: In Ras Al Khaimah private education is regulated by the Department of Knowledge, which, as the UAE government's own guidance on private schools sets out, regulates private education in the emirate and approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. That approval sits with the emirate regulator rather than with a federal body, and it covers courses as well as fees, which is a point most tutoring sites skip entirely.

None of that stops a school offering Additional Mathematics. The constraint is cohort size. An optional extension subject taken by a dozen students in a year group competes for timetable space and for a teacher qualified to teach post-16 pure mathematics, and in a smaller private-school market those teachers are also the ones carrying the AS and A Level classes. The result is a subject that is entered more often than it is taught in dedicated periods.

For a parent this has two consequences worth planning around. First, find out early whether your child's 0606 is a taught course, a lunchtime group or a self-study entry, because those three need very different support. Second, do not assume the nearest tuition centre covers it; group classes in the emirate are built around 0580, 0620, 0625 and 0610 demand, and a 0606 candidate in a 0580 group is paying to revise what they already know.

There is a third consequence that only shows up in Year 12. A student who was entered for 0606 but effectively taught it alone can arrive at AS or Diploma level with a respectable grade and real holes underneath it, because self-study rewards the topics that read easily and quietly skips proof and integration. If that describes your child, the useful conversation in the summer between the two years is not revision but a short audit of which rows of the syllabus were ever properly taught.

sections.heading: The series calendar, counted backwards from the paper
paragraphs: Cambridge runs IGCSE and O Level exams in a June series and a November series, with Primary and Lower Secondary Checkpoint tests in March, May and October. Every centre is allocated to one of six administrative zones, and Cambridge is explicit that it is essential to use the correct version of the timetable for your zone, and that it cannot accept responsibility for candidates who miss an exam after using the wrong one. Ask the exams officer which zone your centre sits in, then read only that timetable.

The dates that surprise parents are not the exam dates. They are the entry dates, which close months earlier, and the forecast-grade dates, which are the school's formal prediction and often the first written statement of where a student stands. Ras Al Khaimah candidates sit the June series and the November series, so the table below is built around those two and nothing else. Cambridge's February and March sitting is offered to India only, which is why a date copied off a forum thread can belong to a series your child will never enter. The exact day for each milestone comes off the centre's statement of entry and the zone timetable on cambridgeinternational.org, and that is the only version to act on.

Read backwards from the window rather than forwards from today. The June papers run from May into June, and the final entry closes in the spring, roughly four months ahead of the first paper, which means tier and subject decisions for 0606 are effectively settled while the second term is still running. A family deciding in April whether to add 0606 has usually already missed the moment when that was a free choice, because the centre has submitted its entries by then and a late one carries a fee the school may decline to pay. The honest answer at that point is the November series, which has its own entry deadline in the summer and its own papers in the autumn, rather than a rushed entry into a series that has already closed.

sections.heading: Where 0606 leads: AS 9709, Maths AA and UAE admissions
paragraphs: The reason to take Additional Mathematics is almost always the year after it. Pure Mathematics 1 in Cambridge AS 9709 revisits quadratics, functions, circular measure, trigonometry, series and the whole of introductory calculus, so a 0606 candidate starts AS having already met most of the first term. Students moving into IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches find the same advantage, particularly at Higher Level where the calculus load is heavy from the start.

Engineering, computer science and economics routes at UAE universities typically expect the stronger mathematics option rather than the applied one, which in IB terms means Analysis and Approaches and in Cambridge terms means A Level Mathematics. Check the published entry requirements for the specific programme and intake year on the university's own site, because requirements differ between institutions and are revised. What 0606 does is make the stronger option a realistic choice rather than a gamble.

On the certificate itself: for Ministry of Education equivalency on the British track, the published requirement is five accredited subjects at GCSE or IGCSE with a grade of no less than E or grade 3, plus one accredited subject at Advanced Level at grade E or two at Advanced Subsidiary Level at the same grade, with Arabic and Islamic education not counted among the five. One ranking competitor states six IGCSE subjects are required; the sourced figure is five. 0606 is an additional accredited subject rather than a replacement for any of them, and equivalency is handled by the Ministry through its own channel, not by any tutoring provider.

sections.heading: Academic honesty, school-set work and what a session contains
paragraphs: Additional Mathematics has no coursework component, which removes one whole category of risk. What remains is the weekly problem set, the school assignment and the mock paper, and the boundary there is simple: a tutor teaches the method, works a parallel example, and then watches the student do their own question. No tutor on this platform produces assessed work for a student, and none will sit alongside a timed school assessment. That is a condition of working here rather than a preference.

In practice a session on a school-set problem runs like this. The student shows the question and their attempt. The tutor identifies which step broke, teaches that step on a different question with different numbers, and then sends the student back to the original. The written record from the lesson shows the parallel example, not the completed homework, which is also what makes it useful revision material in February.

Past papers and mark schemes are a related point. Cambridge owns that material; we reference it, teach from the school's legitimate copies and link to the official site, and do not distribute syllabus documents, mark schemes or grade-boundary tables as downloads. If your child's school has not issued past papers, the exams officer is the right person to ask, and a tutor can tell you precisely which series and which paper numbers are worth the time.

The last part of a session is the part parents see. Each lesson ends with a short written note: the parallel examples worked, the step that broke, and one or two questions to attempt before the next slot. It is deliberately brief, because a long report takes tutor time that belongs in the teaching, and because three honest lines about what is still shaky are more useful in March than a paragraph of encouragement. Those notes accumulate into the revision list for the final fortnight.

faqs.question: Is Cambridge IGCSE Additional Maths 0606 worth taking alongside 0580 Extended?
faqs.answer: For a student heading into AS Mathematics 9709 or IB Analysis and Approaches, usually yes: the overlap with the first AS term is substantial and the head start is real. For a student who is working hard to hold a grade B in 0580 Extended, often no, because 0606 adds a second full qualification examined by two two-hour papers with no coursework cushion. The honest test is not ambition but current fluency in algebra. If rearranging and manipulating expressions is still effortful, the calculus in 0606 will compound that rather than fix it.

faqs.question: Which Ras Al Khaimah schools actually enter candidates for 0606?
faqs.answer: Provision varies by campus and by year, so the only reliable answer comes from your own school. British-curriculum and international campuses that also run post-16 mathematics are the most likely to offer it, because they need the bridge into AS or Diploma study. Several city-side Cambridge centres enter a small number of strong mathematicians each series without timetabling the course separately. Ask the head of mathematics two questions: is 0606 a taught course with its own periods, and who teaches it. The answers decide what support your child actually needs.

faqs.question: My son has a grade A in 0580 but is lost in the 0606 calculus. Where does that gap come from?
faqs.answer: Almost always from algebraic fluency rather than from calculus itself. Differentiating a product is a two-line rule; the difficulty is simplifying what the rule produces, factorising it, setting it to zero and solving, often with surds or trigonometric terms in the way. 0580 Extended rewards accurate work on recognisable question types, so a student can score highly without ever being fast at manipulation. We diagnose this by giving the same stationary-point question twice, once with clean numbers and once as it appears on a 0606 paper.

faqs.question: Is 0606 graded on the same A* to G scale as my daughter's other IGCSEs?
faqs.answer: No. Additional Mathematics is reported on an A* to E scale, so the lower grades that exist in other IGCSE subjects are not available here. In practice that means a candidate who is badly out of their depth does not land on a low grade, they land outside the reported range, and it is one reason schools are selective about entry. Treat the mock result as a real signal rather than an early-days wobble, and if it is very low, raise the question of withdrawing the entry before the final entry date rather than after.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover 0606 and AS Mathematics 9709 in the same year?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for a student moving straight from one to the other it is usually the better arrangement. The content overlap across quadratics, functions, circular measure, trigonometry, series and introductory calculus means a tutor who has taught both can sequence the 0606 work so it doubles as AS groundwork. Tell us at the consultation stage if that is the plan, because it changes which specialist we look for. It also changes the teaching order: proof and calculus come earlier, and matrices later.

faqs.question: Does 0606 count towards the Ministry of Education equivalency subject total?
faqs.answer: Equivalency on the British track asks for five accredited subjects at GCSE or IGCSE with a grade of no less than E or grade 3, with Arabic and Islamic education not counted among the five, plus one Advanced Level subject at grade E or two Advanced Subsidiary subjects at the same grade. Additional Mathematics is an additional accredited subject on that certificate rather than a substitute for any of the five. Equivalency is assessed by the Ministry through its own channel, and current requirements should be read on the Ministry's own site before you rely on them.

faqs.question: How many weekly sessions does a 0606 candidate in Ras Al Khaimah usually need?
faqs.answer: Most families start with one hour a week and move to two in the term before the series. A student who is self-studying the syllabus because the school has not timetabled it generally needs two from the outset, because the tutor is teaching the course rather than supporting it. A student repairing a single topic area may need four to eight sessions and then nothing further. We would rather set the number after the diagnostic lesson than quote a package before anyone has seen the student's work.

faqs.question: We live in Mina Al Arab and the drive to a city tuition centre takes forty minutes. Is an online 0606 lesson the same lesson?
faqs.answer: It is a different format with one significant advantage: the tutor is chosen for the syllabus rather than for proximity. Mathematics teaches well over live video because the work is symbolic and lives on a shared whiteboard that both people write on, and the written record is saved rather than left in a notebook. What you lose is the physical room. What you gain, from Mina Al Arab specifically, is eighty minutes a week of driving back and a teacher who actually teaches Additional Mathematics. IB Gram does not offer home visits anywhere in the UAE; those exist only in India.

faqs.question: What does a 0606 tutor cost in the northern emirates compared with Dubai?
faqs.answer: Published market rates are set in Dubai and quoted in AED. EdFlik advertises online tutoring from AED 45 to 65 an hour, Unitors publishes IGCSE tuition from AED 150, TutorChase quotes around AED 270, and Bestimate's 2026 Dubai cost table puts specialist IB and IGCSE tutoring at AED 200 to 450 and above, with in-home visits at AED 180 to 350 once travel is included. Northern-emirate rates for local in-person help tend to sit lower, but the specialist pool is much thinner. Online teaching prices to the specialism, not the postcode. IB Gram's own rate is given at the consultation.

faqs.question: Can my child sit 0606 as a private candidate if the school does not offer it?
faqs.answer: Entries are made through a Cambridge centre, so the practical route is either your child's own school agreeing to enter them or a centre that accepts private candidates. Start with your school's exams officer, because an entry through the school your child already attends is far simpler administratively than finding an external centre. Ask about the final entry date for the series you are targeting and about any fee the centre charges private candidates. A tutor can teach the syllabus either way, but nobody except a centre can make the entry.

faqs.question: Does 0606 help with IB Maths Analysis and Approaches at Higher Level?
faqs.answer: Yes, more than most people expect. Analysis and Approaches Higher Level moves quickly into calculus, trigonometric identities, sequences and proof, and assumes algebraic fluency from the first week. A candidate who has sat 0606 has already met differentiation, integration, radian measure, binomial expansion and identity proof under exam conditions. It does not cover everything the Diploma adds, particularly proof by induction and the complex-number and vector work at Higher Level, but it removes the first-term shock that catches students arriving straight from 0580.

faqs.question: What should we send a tutor before the first 0606 lesson?
faqs.answer: Three things, and they take five minutes to gather. The statement of entry or subject list, so the tutor knows the series and the papers. The most recent marked 0606 assessment, because the error pattern is already visible on it. And the school's scheme of work or topic list if one exists, so lessons are sequenced with the class rather than against it. If none of that exists because your child is self-studying, say so plainly: it is useful information rather than a problem, and it changes the lesson plan from support to teaching.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with the weekly 0606 problem sets the school sets?
faqs.answer: A tutor teaches the method and works a parallel question, then the student does the set themselves. That boundary is not negotiable here: no assessed work is produced for a student, and nobody sits alongside a timed school assessment. In practice the parallel-example approach is more useful anyway, because what comes out of the lesson is a worked model the student can revise from in February rather than a finished sheet they will not remember. If a school task is actually assessed coursework, we teach around it rather than into it.

faqs.question: Is six weeks before the series too late to start 0606 support?
faqs.answer: It is late, but not pointless, provided the plan changes shape. Six weeks is not enough to teach calculus from nothing to a student who has never differentiated. It is enough to make an already-taught candidate considerably more efficient: timed papers, mark-scheme comparison, method-mark discipline, calculator-mode habits and a pacing budget for eighty marks in two hours. We will tell you honestly which of those two situations your child is in after the diagnostic lesson, including when the better answer is to protect the 0580 grade instead.

intro.heading: 0610 is a precision exam before it is a science exam
paragraphs: Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 covers twenty-one topic areas, from characteristics and classification of living organisms through to biotechnology and genetic modification, and assesses them across three components: a multiple-choice paper worth 30 per cent, a theory paper worth 50 per cent, and either a practical test or an alternative-to-practical paper worth 20 per cent. Core candidates are graded C to G and Extended candidates A* to E. Confirm the exact paper numbers, durations and mark totals for your child's series against the syllabus document on the Cambridge International site, since assessment detail is revised from time to time.

The reason 0610 behaves differently from chemistry or physics is that very little of it is calculation. Almost all of it is explanation, and explanation is marked on wording. A student who writes that osmosis is water moving from high concentration to low concentration has described something real and has not met the mark scheme, which expects water moving down a water potential gradient through a partially permeable membrane. Across a theory paper that distinction appears twenty times, and it is the difference between a competent script and a strong one.

This is why biology produces more frustrated parents than the other two sciences. The child clearly understands the material, can explain it out loud convincingly, revises diligently, and comes home with a B. Nothing is wrong with their understanding. What is missing is the habit of answering in the examination's language: naming the structure, stating the process, giving the direction of movement, and including the word the scheme is looking for. That habit is taught by marking, repeatedly, and almost never by reading a revision guide.

Ras Al Khaimah adds a specific supply problem to that teaching need. The emirate's private-school set is compact and clustered around Al Nakheel, Al Hamra and Mina Al Arab, and the u.ae private-schools page states that the Department of Knowledge regulates private education here, approving tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. Biology sets are small as a result, and the number of people within driving distance who have marked 0610 scripts against the published scheme is smaller still. A family searching inside the emirate is choosing from a handful of names; a family searching for someone who has marked the papers is choosing from a national pool.

What a parent can check for themselves is the subject of a whole section further down, because almost nothing in this market is verifiable and a few things genuinely are. Published market rates, for instance: EdFlik advertises from AED 45 to AED 65 an hour and Tutopiya from AED 33 to AED 52; Unitors publishes AED 150 as its IGCSE starting rate; TutorChase quotes AED 270; Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table puts examined-subject specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 and above and in-home visits at AED 180 to AED 350. Those figures are on the providers' own pages and in that survey, and anyone can open them. IB Gram delivers 0610 as one-to-one tuition over live video and does not visit homes anywhere in the UAE, since in-home tutoring is a service we run only in India.

ras-al-khaimah/cambridge-igcse-biology-0.programmesIntro: Biology is the science most often taken by students heading for medicine, dentistry, veterinary science or biomedical routes, and those destinations set real requirements. In Ras Al Khaimah the local post-16 provision is narrow enough that the route should be identified before Year 11 rather than after results.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Biology (0610)
programmes.description: Two years, two tiers and three assessed components. The content volume is the largest of the three sciences and the conceptual difficulty is the lowest, which produces a characteristic failure pattern: students who understand everything and have never been made to write it in the scheme's wording. The practical component is worth a fifth of the grade and is the part most commonly left unrevised.
programmes.countryNote: RAK schools generally teach biology in a single set per year group, so the breadth of the twenty-one topics is covered at one pace for one cohort. A student who misses the transport topics in Year 10 does not meet them again in class, because there is no second set running the material later in the year.

programmes.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level Biology (9700)
programmes.description: Requires Extended 0610 in practice and a strong grade at most centres. It deepens cell biology, immunity, gene expression and ecology substantially, and the practical assessment carries more weight and more technique than at IGCSE. The precision demand rises rather than relaxes: a student who reached a good IGCSE grade on approximate wording finds AS marking considerably less forgiving.
programmes.countryNote: Sixth-form science provision in the northern emirates sits in a small number of schools, so continuing often means an application beyond Ras Al Khaimah. The Year 11 predicted grade therefore does admissions work as well as qualification work, which argues for building marked evidence during the autumn term.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme Biology
programmes.description: Taken at SL or HL with examination papers plus an internal assessment: an individual scientific investigation the student designs, carries out and writes up against published criteria. Extended 0610 content maps onto it well. The investigation does not resemble anything at IGCSE, and the marks sit heavily in research question framing, methodology and evaluation rather than in the biology itself.
programmes.countryNote: Diploma provision in this emirate is limited, so students taking this route usually change school at 16. Where we support a Diploma investigation, the design, the data and the writing remain the student's own throughout; a tutor teaches, reviews and comments, and will not produce any part of assessed work.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Combined and Co-ordinated Sciences
programmes.description: The route where biology is examined together with chemistry and physics rather than separately. Coverage per subject is narrower and the grade reflects performance across all three. It suits students who need science breadth without three separate terminal science examinations inside one series, which is a real timetable consideration in Year 11.
programmes.countryNote: Several northern-emirate schools place part of the cohort on a combined-science route, and the first question any tutor should ask is which qualification the school has actually entered the student for. A combined-science candidate needs a different revision sequence from a 0610 candidate, and confusing the two wastes weeks.

ras-al-khaimah/cambridge-igcse-biology-0.subjectsIntro: Biology shares its assessment shape with the other two sciences and competes with them for the same revision evenings. These notes set out what each neighbouring subject assesses and where the overlap with 0610 helps or hurts.

subjects.name: Biology (0610)
subjects.description: This page's subject. Twenty-one topics across three components. Marks are lost to imprecise definitions, incomplete process sequences and an unrevised practical paper rather than to genuine conceptual gaps.

subjects.name: Chemistry (0620)
subjects.description: The same three-component shape with a far higher calculation load. Moles, electrolysis and organic chemistry account for most of its lost marks, so it competes for different revision time than biology does.

subjects.name: Physics (0625)
subjects.description: The most algebraic of the three sciences, with a practical or alternative paper worth a fifth of the grade. Students weak in rearranging formulae lose physics marks for reasons that have nothing to do with physics.

subjects.name: Mathematics (0580)
subjects.description: Two equally weighted papers per tier, one without a calculator. Biology needs less of it than the other sciences, but percentage change, magnification and ratio reasoning all appear and all cost marks when shaky.

subjects.name: Combined and Co-ordinated Sciences
subjects.description: The route where all three sciences are examined together. Confirm which qualification the school has entered before any plan is written, because the revision sequence differs substantially from a 0610 candidate's.

subjects.name: English as a Second Language (0510 / 0511)
subjects.description: The subject with the largest hidden effect on a biology grade. 0610 is marked on precision of wording, so a student working in a second language can hold the understanding and still miss the scheme's required terms.

subjects.name: Geography (0460)
subjects.description: Overlaps genuinely with 0610's ecology and human-influences topics: nutrient cycles, deforestation, pollution and population pressure appear in both, assessed in different formats.

subjects.name: Food and Nutrition
subjects.description: Shares 0610's human-nutrition content, including the balanced diet, deficiency conditions and digestion. Where a school offers it, students taking both find a genuine overlap in one topic area.

subjects.name: Physical Education
subjects.description: Overlaps with the respiration, gas exchange and circulation topics in 0610, often with the same diagrams. The assessment model is different, but the content reinforcement is real.

sections.heading: The twenty-one topics and how they land across the three components
paragraphs: Biology's difficulty is breadth. Twenty-one topic areas is roughly double what students expect from a single subject, and they are not equally examined or equally forgiving. The classification, organisation and movement-into-cells topics at the start of the syllabus are heavily definition-based and appear reliably in the multiple-choice paper. The transport, coordination and inheritance topics in the middle generate the longest theory questions and the most process-sequence marks. The ecology and biotechnology topics at the end are frequently taught last, revised least, and worth a real share of the paper.

The three components reward different things. The multiple-choice paper rewards precise recall and punishes approximate knowledge quietly: a student who half-remembers a definition will choose a plausible distractor without noticing. The theory paper rewards explanation in the scheme's language, which is where most recoverable marks sit. The practical component rewards technique — method, variables, error, recording, interpretation — and is worth a fifth of the grade on its own.

What follows from that is a revision order most students do not use. Rather than working through twenty-one topics in syllabus sequence, the useful approach is to find out from a marked paper which topics are costing marks and in which component, then repair those. A student losing marks in the multiple-choice paper on the early topics has a recall problem that short daily drilling fixes. A student losing theory marks across the middle topics has a wording problem that only marking fixes. Those are different jobs and a single generic revision plan addresses neither.

sections.heading: Definition marks: why strong students stop one word short
paragraphs: This is the specific mechanism behind most disappointing 0610 grades and it is worth setting out precisely, because once a parent can see it they can check for it themselves. Mark schemes for biology explanation questions award marks for named components of an answer. A two-mark definition typically needs two things: what the thing is, and the condition or qualifier that makes it that thing rather than something adjacent. Students reliably supply the first and omit the second, which scores one mark out of two and reads, to a parent, like a correct answer.

Take three familiar examples. Diffusion described as movement from high to low concentration misses the net movement of particles down a concentration gradient. Active transport described as movement against a gradient misses that it uses energy from respiration and proteins in the cell membrane. Transpiration described as water loss from leaves misses evaporation and diffusion of water vapour from within the plant to the atmosphere. In each case the student knows the biology. In each case half the marks have gone.

The repair is a drill and not a concept. The student builds their own glossary from past mark schemes rather than from a revision guide, writes each definition from memory, and has it marked against the scheme's wording until the required terms appear automatically. Thirty to forty definitions covers most of the recurring single-mark losses in the subject. It is unglamorous work, it takes about five sessions with daily practice between them, and it moves more marks per hour invested than any content teaching in the syllabus.

Process sequences are the same problem at greater length. A question asking how a nerve impulse produces a response, or how the body regulates blood glucose, expects the stages in order with the named structures and the direction of each step. Students write a paragraph that contains most of the stages in roughly the right order and lose the sequencing marks. Writing these as numbered steps, then being marked on them, is the entire fix.

sections.heading: Which boards and which schools: biology provision in this emirate
paragraphs: Ras Al Khaimah regulates its own private education. The u.ae private-schools page states that the emirate's Department of Knowledge regulates private education, and that Ras Al Khaimah's authority, like Sharjah's, approves tuition fees, curricula, programmes, courses, activities and assessment methods. Curriculum approval sitting with the emirate regulator rather than with a federal body is the reason a school's subject offer is not purely a commercial decision, and it is worth knowing before asking a school why it does not run a second science set.

What that means for biology specifically is set-size. The emirate's school population is small, the schools are concentrated near Al Nakheel and Khuzam with southern provision at Al Hamra, and separate sciences are typically taught in a single set per year group. One teacher therefore carries the full twenty-one topics for the whole cohort, at one pace, with one lab schedule. That is a perfectly workable model for a school and it has two consequences for an individual student: a topic missed is not revisited, and individual marking of long explanation answers is limited by arithmetic rather than by willingness.

The board matters too, and families should establish it in writing before buying any help. Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology are different qualifications with different papers, different practical arrangements and different mark-scheme conventions, and past papers are not interchangeable in practice. Ask the exams officer for the board and the syllabus code. A tutor drilling the wrong board's wording conventions will actively cost marks, which is a worse outcome than no tutoring at all.

sections.heading: Extended-only biology: the content that separates A* from B
paragraphs: Both tiers cover the same twenty-one topic areas, and the Extended tier adds supplement content within them. That structure confuses families, because it means Extended is not a separate syllabus with separate topics but the same topics carried further. A student can therefore feel entirely familiar with a topic and still be unprepared for the Extended questions on it, which is a more insidious problem than simply not having covered something.

The supplement material concentrates in identifiable places. Movement into and out of cells gains water potential terminology and more demanding osmosis explanation. Transport in animals gains more detailed heart and vessel structure. Coordination and response gains fuller treatment of hormonal control and homeostasis. Inheritance gains more complex genetic crosses and the molecular basis of variation. Biotechnology and genetic modification gains considerably more process detail. Those five areas are where a B becomes an A, and they are also where a single school set is most likely to compress coverage under time pressure.

For a student aiming at Extended, the practical implication is to treat those areas as named targets rather than as parts of topics already covered. The table gives working session estimates, which assume the Core content underneath is secure and the student does the between-session work. They are estimates and not promises; nobody can attach a grade to a number of hours, and a provider who does should be read sceptically. What can be said is that these five areas are where additional hours produce the most movement at the top of the scale.

sections.heading: Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies beside a triple-science timetable
paragraphs: A Year 11 student taking three separate sciences in Ras Al Khaimah has a fuller week than the option block suggests, and the reason is not the international curriculum. Private schools in the UAE teach Arabic, social studies and Islamic studies alongside whichever curriculum they are licensed for. The federal position is that private schools are not obliged to follow a specific curriculum beyond Arabic language, social studies and Islamic studies, while adhering to the Ministry's general regulations. These are timetabled lessons with their own assessment, not enrichment slots that can be traded away.

KHDA's published mandatory-subjects guidance, which describes Dubai's arrangements, is the clearest public account of how this works in practice, and it is useful for understanding the model even though it is not the Ras Al Khaimah regulator's document. It calculates instructional time on a 40-minute lesson unit, allows schools to vary lesson length provided total weekly time is met, and advises that any mandatory subject lesson runs at least 25 minutes. It requires separate classes for Arabs and non-Arabs in Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies, stating that combined classes are strictly prohibited because the curriculum expectations and language of instruction differ, and it prohibits using different or additional content without prior Ministry of Education permission.

The arithmetic consequence for a biology plan is straightforward. Three sciences, mathematics, English, the mandatory subjects and one or two options leave fewer free evenings than a parent assumes, and in Ras Al Khaimah the free ones start late because of the drives. Twenty-one biology topics cannot be covered in whatever time is left over after everything else; the time has to be allocated first. In practice that means one fixed weekly session, protected, with the definition drilling happening in short daily bursts rather than in long weekend blocks that collide with the other two sciences.

sections.heading: Sessions, retakes and the published timetables worth planning against
paragraphs: Exam sessions are the part of this subject where families most often act on rumour, so here are the sourced facts. Cambridge International runs IGCSE and O Level exams in a June series and a November series, with Primary and Lower Secondary Checkpoint tests in March, May and October. Every centre is allocated to one of six administrative zones, Cambridge states that it is essential to use the correct version of the timetable for your zone, and it says it cannot accept responsibility for candidates who miss an exam after the wrong zone timetable was used. Get the zone and the timetable from your school's exams officer in writing.

Where a school uses Pearson Edexcel instead, the published pattern is also concrete. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE exams are available in May/June and November each year. The November 2026 final timetable runs from late October to 19 November 2026. June 2026 results went to centres on 19 August 2026 and to students on 20 August 2026, and November 2025 results reached students on 22 January 2026. Pearson also publishes provisional timetables ahead of each June and November series, usually a year or more out, which is why a plan should link the live official timetable rather than restate dates that can be revised before the statement of entry ever arrives.

Those dates matter for retakes more than for first entries. A student disappointed in a summer series and considering a November retake is working with a short window: results arrive in August, the November timetable runs to mid-November, and the entry has to be made through a centre. The decision therefore has to be taken within days of results rather than contemplated over a month. In a small emirate the additional constraint is whether a local centre enters that series at all, which is a question for the school and not for a tutoring platform.

One scheduling note specific to Ras Al Khaimah. The long revision run-up to a June series can overlap Ramadan, when school days shorten and household routines move into the evening, and the same is true of the early entry work for a November series when Ramadan falls in the first weeks of the academic year. The approach that holds up is to complete the heavy timed-paper work in the weeks before, and to use the Ramadan weeks for shorter definition drilling and correction review, which suits this subject well because biology revision breaks into small pieces more naturally than chemistry or physics does.

sections.heading: What a parent can actually verify before paying anybody
paragraphs: Very little in this market is checkable, which is precisely why the checkable things are worth using. Start with the rates, because they are published and anyone can open them. EdFlik advertises from AED 45 to AED 65 an hour and Tutopiya from AED 33 to AED 52. Unitors publishes AED 150 as its IGCSE starting rate and AED 200 for IB. TutorChase quotes AED 270. Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table gives in-home one-to-one at AED 180 to AED 350, independent home tutors at AED 200 to AED 500, and examined-subject specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 and above, with BartyED at AED 650 at the named-premium end. A quote far outside those bands is not necessarily wrong, but it should come with a reason.

Next, verify the permit position for anyone tutoring inside the UAE. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is issued through the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, and u.ae states that it is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, government and private-sector employees, unemployed individuals, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's own service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time. Anyone quoting you a price for the permit is wrong, and u.ae states that tutoring without one carries fines and penalties under the applicable laws, with no schedule of amounts published.

Then verify subject knowledge with three questions that have checkable answers. How many topic areas are in the 0610 syllabus, and what are the three components worth? What exactly does a two-mark definition of active transport need to include? And can we see a marked script, with the student's name removed? Vague answers to any of those indicate somebody who knows biology rather than somebody who knows 0610. Finally, be sceptical of what cannot be verified: self-published star ratings, student numbers with no method, and any promise attached to a grade. No tutor can promise an outcome, and claims of that kind are the clearest signal available that the rest of the page should not be trusted either.
